messages:
Nadia Singh: Vendor update from Zenith: they located 10 H100s flagged DOA from PO Z-1975. They propose a hybrid flow: 3 immediate air replacements to APAC critical racks, 7 refurb-to-staging with 72h burn-in. They want to net 80% credit for DOAs, rest held as spare-pool credit. Thoughts?
Ethan Park: what's lead time for new air replacements vs refurb? Cost delta?
Liu Wei: air new ~5-7d including customs, refurb to staging ~3d but requires burn-in. If refurb passes, we save ~$1.1k/unit vs air. Risk: refurbished units have a slightly higher early-failure rate.
zenith-ops: correct on timings. For air we can prioritize earliest pickup but FOB delays may add 24-48h. Refurb includes depot stress logs and warranty for 60 days. We can provide serial-level QA PDFs.
Nadia Singh: we need to protect prod. Recommend 3 air to apac-prod-1 + 7 refurb to FRA-staging with explicit hold: do not deploy refurb into prod until 24h burn-in + thermal sweep and ingestion test. Procurement to attach RMA ZEN-RMA-2026-499 to PO.
Ethan Park: agree. I'll prepare a burn-in checklist (cpu/thermal/kv-cache stability, 24h load test). Also flag which serials go into hot spares.
Liu Wei: finance - will they accept 80% credit? If not we escalate. Also confirm HS code 8542.31 to minimize customs reclassification risk.
zenith-ops: HS code confirmed as 8542.31 for export docs. We can accept RMA credit at 80% applied to next invoice; if Redwood retains refurbished units in spare pool for 90 days we can increase to 90% credit.
ops-bot: RMA created: ZEN-RMA-2026-499 (status: pending-depot-inspect). Link: https://zenith.example.com/rma/ZEN-RMA-2026-499
Nadia Singh: decision: accept hybrid. 3 air new -> apac-prod-1, 7 refurb -> FRA-staging. Condition: vendor must provide QA PDFs and agree to 24h burn-in gate. Finance to hold 80% provisional credit; legal to review holdback if vendor wants spare-pool retention. Zenith, please confirm pickup ETAs and AWB.
zenith-ops: pickup ETA for air leg 2026-03-27 02:00 UTC. We'll upload AWB and QA reports within 18h.
Ethan Park: I'll post the burn-in checklist and map serials in 1h.
Nadia Singh: thanks all, escalate to me if vendor changes terms. Thread saved for audit. :white_check_mark:
